newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Globe awards $60 mln supply contracts.
newsitem.headline: Globe awards $60 mln supply contracts.

text.p: Globe Telecom GMCR said on Tuesday it had awarded $60 million worth of supply contracts to two groups of Japanese companies.

It contracted Fujitsu Ltd, its local subsidiary Fujitsu Phils Inc and Tomen Corp to deliver, install, test and commission its outside plant systems in the Makati financial district, Bacoor, Batangas, Mindoro Oriental, Mindoro Occidental and Palawan in central Philippines.

The second contract, worth $24 million, was awarded to Sumitomo Corp and its subsidiary Sumisho Machinery Trade Corp, to supply telephone lines in Mandaluyong, Pasig, San Juan and Marikina districts, Cavite and Iligan in southern Philippines.
